title: Fluttering Hearts
author: Anindita Bose
text:
my dreams are not stagnant
for I do not hold onto them

it`s an art learnt by my soul
in some ancient world,

you keep asking why I have
shifted and moved away
from our relationship

I chose silence and smiled
several days...

but my soul revolted and
turned a hundred times to let
you know,

you imagined love or a
fleeting emotion and my
soul saw the fallacy

if your truth itself is flawed
then how will a flowing
energy of love revolve around
you for long...

ah, let`s not listen to my soul
instead drink some red wine
and be friends till we part
again
